g.text: Chris Pratt to Continue ‘Terminal List’ Story in ‘Savage Son’ Series for Amazon ◆ Did Midterm Elections Cause Changes in News World Order? ◆ 20th Television Comms SVP Shari Rosenblum to Exit Studio After 26 Years ◆ Fox Entertainment Studios Signs First-Look Deal With Lisa Hamilton Daly and Alysia Cotter Thomas’ Cottage Industry Entertainment ◆ Wyatt Russell’s Monsterverse Series at Apple TV Adds Tim Robbins, Giancarlo Esposito ◆ Kimmarie Johnson, ‘Beverly Hills, 90210’ Actress and Miss USA Contestant, Dies at 50 ◆
